name: Needham
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Needham, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Needham, MA: the Blue Tree Lighting with Santa on the Town Common, a free church concert, and the Needham Line trains.
lede: Needham does Christmas around its Town Common, where the town lights a big tree in blue every December and Santa leads the countdown in front of Town Hall.
celebrates: The heart of the season is the Blue Tree Lighting on the Town Common in front of Needham Town Hall on Highland Avenue. The Town of Needham runs it as a free evening with music from local students, a countdown led by Santa and photos with him afterward. The town's forestry crew strings thousands of lights across the Common and hangs lit wreaths on Town Hall, and Avery Square gets a lit tree of its own. Needham churches add free holiday concerts, and the Needham Free Public Library plans family programs through December. Families can ride the Needham Line into Boston for more holiday sights.
lastyear: In 2025 Needham held its 71st tree lighting on the Town Common, Needham Local reported. The tree was a 30 foot sugar maple, decorated by town arborists working with a crew from Hartney Greymont. Forestry Foreman Mike Logan said the tree carried at least 700 lights, the wreaths on Town Hall about 400, and the Common close to 2,500 in all. Parks and Forestry Superintendent Ed Olsen helped oversee the work.
facts: Needham has been lighting a tree on its Town Common for more than seven decades, and 2025 was the 71st time. The tree it once used was a huge maple that Needham Local described as about 80 feet tall and 60 feet wide. In 2023 the ceremony returned to a newly renovated Town Common, on a Saturday evening from 5 to 6 pm, the town announced. The lights are blue, which is why people call it the Blue Tree Lighting.
trains: Needham has four stations on the MBTA Needham Line: Hersey, Needham Junction, Needham Center and Needham Heights. Needham Center is a short walk from the Town Common, so families can ride in from Boston or out from Needham to see the holiday lights downtown. The line runs to South Station in Boston, so check the MBTA timetable for weekend and holiday schedules. For a Christmas train ride, Edaville in Carver runs holiday trains through its lights each season.

kidfact: Needham's Christmas tree glows blue instead of the usual colors, and in 2025 it had at least 700 lights on it.
faq: Where is the Needham tree lighting?

The Town of Needham holds its Blue Tree Lighting on the Town Common in front of Town Hall at 1471 Highland Avenue. Santa leads the countdown and then stays to pose for photos with families, and students and local groups perform before the lights go on. The town lists the evening as free on its official calendar each year.
Why is it called the Blue Tree Lighting?

The tree on the Needham Town Common is strung with blue lights, so the town calls the evening the Blue Tree Lighting. Town forestry crews and arborists put up the lights, and in 2025 the tree alone carried at least 700 of them, with about 2,500 lights across the whole Common, Needham Local reported.
How long has Needham had a tree lighting?

A long time. Needham Local reported that the 2025 lighting was the 71st on the Town Common. The ceremony took place on a newly renovated Common in 2023, and it has stayed a free town event with music and a visit from Santa in front of Town Hall.
Can we take the train to Needham for Christmas events?

Yes. The MBTA Needham Line stops at Hersey, Needham Junction, Needham Center and Needham Heights. Needham Center station is close to the Town Common and Town Hall. Check the MBTA timetable before you go, since weekend and holiday service can differ from weekday trains.
